routes.name: Tourist Visa
routes.summary: Everyone needs a visa before arriving. Apply through an Eritrean embassy. The Washington embassy lists a fee of USD 50. The Indian embassy says one month validity from entry.

other: Embassy practices differ by country, confirm with your nearest embassy

stay.note: Per the Embassy in India. Extendable in Eritrea depending on visa type.

sources.label: Embassy of Eritrea, Washington DC visa list

routes.name: Business Visa
routes.summary: Your host in Eritrea starts the process with the immigration department. Then the embassy issues it. The Washington embassy lists several durations.

other: Host organization must start approval in Eritrea (per Embassy in India)

sources.label: Embassy of Eritrea, Washington DC visa list

routes.name: Transit Visa
routes.summary: Listed by the Washington embassy. You need an air ticket itinerary and a visa for your final destination.

sources.label: Embassy of Eritrea, Washington DC visa list

routes.name: Employment Visa
routes.summary: Needs a letter from the sponsoring employer in Eritrea. Your employer starts the process with the immigration department.

other: Employment letter stating role and duration

sources.label: Embassy of Eritrea, Washington DC visa list

routes.name: Student Visa
routes.summary: Needs a letter from the school stating purpose and length of stay, plus proof of funds.

sources.label: Embassy of Eritrea, Washington DC visa list

routes.name: Family Visit Visa
routes.summary: For visiting relatives. Needs proof of funds and a reference living in Eritrea.

sources.label: Embassy of Eritrea, Washington DC visa list
